His conditions of service were governed by the Subordinate Agriculture Service Rules. Rule 25 4 of these Rules permits the Director of Agricul- ture to terminate the services of a person on probation by giving him one months notice if that person has not made sufficient use of his opportunities or if he has otherwise failed to give satisfaction. The termination of the appellants services under r. 25 4 does not amount to dismissal or removal from service within the meaning of Art. 311 as it was in accordance with the terms of the conditions of service applicable to the appellant.
